papers_found.title: AdaptiveTrend: Systematic Trend-Following with Adaptive Portfolio Construction
papers_found.summary: Crypto trend-following framework with dynamic trailing stop calibrated to intra-day volatility. Sharpe 2.41, MaxDD -12.7%, Calmar 3.18 over 2022-2024 on 150+ crypto pairs. Monthly adaptive portfolio construction with asymmetric 70/30 long-short.
papers_found.relevance_reason: Directly maps to H264b — trailing stop mechanism to fix H264 2022 bear drawdown problem

papers_found.title: Discovery of a 13-Sharpe OOS Factor: Drift Regimes Unlock Hidden Cross-Sectional Predictability
papers_found.summary: Regime-conditional value+reversal factor on S&P 500 2004-2024. Drift regime = stock has >60% positive days in trailing 63-day window. OOS Sharpe >13 at $100-500M capacity, 33.6% annualized at $1B, 12% vol, -11.9% MaxDD. Walk-forward validated with p < 0.001.
papers_found.relevance_reason: Highly novel regime-activation mechanism directly applicable to our cross-sectional momentum pipeline as H265. Skepticism: Sharpe 13 is extraordinary and likely capacity-limited.

papers_found.title: Dynamic Multi-Pair Trading Strategy in Cryptocurrency Markets with Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers_found.summary: PPO+LSTM agent for crypto pairs trading with 'Filter-then-Rank' pair selection and 'Fixed Risk, Adaptive Mean' execution. Binance USD-M Futures 1-hour data. Outperforms heuristic baseline, but only significant at 10% level (not 5%).
papers_found.relevance_reason: Crypto pairs trading is interesting but statistical evidence is weak (10% not 5%), no specific Sharpe numbers, and intraday data doesn't match our monthly framework.

papers_found.title: Predicting Stock Price Direction on Earnings Announcement Days using Multi-modal Deep Learning
papers_found.summary: Combines FinBERT sentiment scores + 15 fundamental metrics + 3 price indicators. LSTM and Transformer models compared. Transformer achieves higher macro F1. Ablation confirms sentiment adds incremental value.
papers_found.relevance_reason: Potential PEAD H260 enhancement path — multi-modal fusion confirms FinBERT+fundamentals is the right direction, but no specific OOS numbers to assess feasibility.

papers_found.title: Extracting the Structure of Press Releases for Predicting Earnings Announcement Returns
papers_found.summary: Structural extraction from earnings press releases (not just sentiment) for predicting post-announcement returns. Documents PEAD persistence and textual structure predictability.
papers_found.relevance_reason: Background support for structural NLP on earnings documents beyond pure sentiment. Relevant to H258/H260 but not immediately actionable without the full paper metrics.

papers_found.title: Taming the Black Swan: AEGIS Momentum-Gated Hierarchical Optimisation
papers_found.summary: AEGIS framework: volatility-adjusted momentum filter + minimax correlation diversification + SLSQP Sortino optimization. Matched NASDAQ-100 returns with reduced downside volatility, 2006-2025. Profitability in 90% of tested years.
papers_found.relevance_reason: Momentum crash avoidance framework is wiki-worthy for algorithms/momentum-strategies.md, but no OOS Sharpe number provided. Not immediately hypothesis-actionable.
